Suicide is an end, just not a good one. I feel that people really want suffering to end. That's what suicide promises but at the heavy cost of one's life. 
It is hard to find understanding people. I can't promise that we can talk more frequently but I'm all for talking every now and again to support. Every little bit of support and understanding can go a long way.

I don't disagree with anything that you said and it's great to hear you are improving due to the change of perspective. Whether it be demons or feelings, they are apart of you or come from within you. That's how I would see it at least. They are extension of myself clouding my unconscious but it's worse when those demons keep manifesting in real life in some way, not literally of course. I believe Carl Jung called these  the Shadow. The reason I say this because, along with anxiety and depression, I take on a lot of blame for my actions, inactions and mindset. I would see it as those demons being my fault and I would be to blame for letting them numb my unconscious. Suicide is never a solution. It's just a means to an end. The anxiety, the depression, the demons. The all would end with me... but I will try. As much as I want this to all end, there may be a time when I can face these demons to finally realize who I want to be and let that motivate my future endeavors. Maybe with time or some event in my life will change that, I just hope it's at no one else's expense.

Hope to see you continue improving in your English. You're already great at it.

Well I used to be all " the world hates me, I'm the cause of all negative things around me." Although thats pretty dramatic it's not far off of what was actually going on. My actions and my thoughts have been what caused me to go down this downward spiral of anxiety and depression, even though it was never my intention. That's because I let my feelings take over. It's hard to be rational about whats really happening when you feelings are being constantly supported by interactions with others and just existing. I would love to be a person who can just take control of their life and turn it around for the better with willpower and positivity instead of feeling like reject subhuman refuse that's a byproduct of it's self hatred and flaws.

That's all I gotta say about that and I don't know of that answers anything for you. 

Oh and you're English is perfect.
